messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up 11 Exec escalation: AureliaBiotech needs SOC2 evidence, VPC peering (east-us), and PO terms before legal signs the pilot SOW. They want confirmation by EOD Tue.

pooja_se: Quick clarifying q: VPC peering required for the whole pilot or just management plane? Customer message: "strict data path in private subnet".

carmen_ciso: CISO (Aurelia) here 11 need SOC2 type II snapshot or attest, and we require peering for data plane. Management plane can use our SSO. Also they asked about id token rotation policy.

pooja_se: We can do peering for data plane on Dedicated; for Hosted we'd propose Private deployment. @tom_infra can you confirm network pre-reqs and timeline?

ticket-bot: Ticket NET-8812 created by pooja_se: https://tracker.redwood/NET-8812

tom_infra: We need an IP block from Aurelia and an infra change window. ETA: 3 business days to set up peering + validation. I'll attach the network checklist to NET-8812.

kevin_cto: On SOC2 11 we have a SOC2 summary + control matrix (internal) but no public Type II report for this quarter. We can provide the SOC2 summary and AICPA auditor contact. Legal may accept an attestation letter for pilot.

contracts: PO requirement 11 do they require a supplier form? If they need purchase order and net-30, we need to confirm finance acceptance. Also flag: revenue recognition for credits.

alex_sales: Customer asks for net-30 PO + a 10% pilot discount. Can Finance accept net-30 for a first-time pilot?

contracts: Finance ok with net-30 for pilots under $10k. For discounts >5% we need approval from revenue ops. I'll ping them.

pooja_se: Action list: (1) tom raise NET-8812 attachments + peering checklist (2) kevin provide SOC2 summary + attestation note (3) contracts confirm discount approval + PO flow (4) alex update customer. Target: EOD Tue.

tom_infra: Attached to NET-8812: /artifacts/aurelia/peering_checklist.md and peering_runbook_v2.md. Also scheduling change window Fri 9-11 UTC.

ticket-bot: NET-8812 updated: attachments added by tom_infra.

kevin_cto: Uploaded SOC2_summary_2026.pdf and SOC_attestation_letter.docx to https://redwood-internal/compliance/aurelia. The attestation includes our auditor contact.

contracts: Revenue ops approved 10% pilot discount for customer segment "bio-research". Finance confirms net-30. Sending SOW redline to Alex by EOD.

alex_sales: Uploaded SOW redline request to contracts. Customer ok with peering window Fri 9-11 UTC. I'll confirm PO timeline.

carmen_ciso: One last ask: token rotation policy snippet. We need rotation <= 90 days and hardware-backed keys for production. Can we provide a short policy blurb for the SOW?

kevin_cto: Policy: keys rotated every 60 days for customer-managed KMS; token expiry kept to 15m for access tokens. For production we recommend HSM-backed KMS. I'll add a 2-line snippet for SOW.

contracts: SOW redline sent to Alex_sales. Included peering appendix, SOC2 attestation reference, token rotation snippet, PO net-30 and 10% discount line.

alex_sales: Great work team. I'll send SOW + PO instructions to Aurelia now and request signed PO by Mon COB. Will update thread when received.

ticket-bot: NET-8812 status changed: "Peering scheduled" by tom_infra.

alex_sales: Update: Aurelia acknowledged SOW and will route PO internally. Closing ask for exec escalation unless PO misses Mon COB. Thanks everyone.

pooja_se: :rocket:
